properties.displayName: Top custom plugins with high execution time
properties.description: This query pack will show the top custom plugins with high execution time in seconds
properties.body:
[format('dependencies
| where type == ''Plugin''
| where name startswith "{0}" // filtering the OOB plugins
| extend executionTimeInMS = todouble(duration)
| extend cd = parse_json(customDimensions)
| extend depth = toint(cd.depth)
| where success == ''True''
| summarize percentiles(executionTimeInMS, 10, 50, 90, 95, 98), NumOfRequests = count(), MaxDepth = max(depth), AvgExecutionTime= toint(avg(executionTimeInMS/1000)) by name
| join kind = inner ( dependencies
| summarize NumOfTotalRequests = count() by name ) on name
| project-away name1
| extend PassRate = todouble(NumOfRequests) * 100 / NumOfTotalRequests
| extend PT95vsPT50Ratio = iif(percentile_executionTimeInMS_50 != 0, percentile_executionTimeInMS_95 / percentile_executionTimeInMS_50, toreal(0))
//| where percentile_executionTimeInMS_90 > 500
| where AvgExecutionTime > 0.5
| project-rename Namespace=name, ExecutionTimeinMS_90=percentile_executionTimeInMS_95, ExecutionCount = NumOfTotalRequests, Depth=MaxDepth
| project Namespace, ExecutionCount, AvgExecutionTime, percentile_executionTimeInMS_50, ExecutionTimeinMS_90, Depth
| order by ExecutionTimeinMS_90 desc', parameters('querypacks_DataversePlugins_tenantPluginNamespace'))]

properties.description: This query pack will show the max depth of custom plugins
properties.body:
[format('dependencies
| where type == ''Plugin''
| extend cd = parse_json(customDimensions)
| extend depth = toint(cd.depth)
| where name startswith "{0}" // filtering the OOB plugins
| where depth > 1
| summarize count(), (P95)=percentiles(duration,95), (P95s)=percentile(toint(duration),95) by depth, name, bin(timestamp, 1d)
| order by depth
| where isnotempty(P95)
| project name, depth, timestamp, count_, P95
| summarize MaxDepth = max(depth) by name
| order by MaxDepth desc, name asc', parameters('querypacks_DataversePlugins_tenantPluginNamespace'))]

properties.description: This query pack will show the success rate of custom plugins
properties.body:
[format('dependencies
| where type == "Plugin"
| project timestamp, success, correlationId = customDimensions.correlationId, Plugin = customDimensions.pluginType, CustomValidation = customDimensions.stage == 10
| where Plugin startswith "{0}" // filtering the OOB plugins
| summarize NumberOfRequest = count(), Passed = dcountif(timestamp, success == "True"), Failed = dcountif(timestamp, success == "False") by tostring(Plugin), CustomValidation
| extend SuccessRate = todecimal(100*Passed/(Passed + Failed))
| order by CustomValidation desc, SuccessRate asc
| limit 20', parameters('querypacks_DataversePlugins_tenantPluginNamespace'))]
